1) Pick a number between 2 and 9
2) Multiply your number by 10
3) Subtract 10 from your answer
4) Multiply your answer by 10
5) Add 100 to your answer
6) Divide your answer by 100
7) You should be back at the number you started at!

How does this magic trick work? Can you make your own maths magic trick involving multiplication and division by 10 or 100?
